head: STOP USING
<g>BLAND</g>
COVER
LETTERS.
hacks: Generic praise shows you copied and pasted your letter.
Name one recent piece of work they published or launched.
Link your skills to their need.
Employers want to know what you will do for them.
Write: "My society work helps with your launch team."
Words like passionate and motivated carry no real weight.
Swap "I am passionate" for a concrete example of your work.
It proves you understand how their team operates.
If they say client instead of customer, match their word.
Long walls of text get skipped by busy recruiters.
Limit every paragraph to three clear sentences.
out: Send it to a uni friend
